outcome_summary: All 10 work packages in the multi-credential-support rework cycle were delivered with 0 rework iterations. The cycle hardened the credential subsystem with audit logging (5 event types, no token leakage), host/credential coherence validation, hostname format and field-length guards, and legacy dead-code removal. GUI credential badge state was made reload-persistent via health-report seeding, the emoji badge was replaced with an accessible CSS span utility, and a chronic test hang in notes-collected.test.mjs was resolved. Backend tests grew from 902 to 919 passing; GUI tests reached 237 passing; 0 critical or high security findings were recorded across all security-audit pipelines.
